actionType.description: Which decision this task represents: SubmitMedicalEvidence, AuthoriseSettlement, AuthoriseSupplementalTreatment, AuthoriseInvestigativeRestriction, or ConfirmClosure

caseInstanceId.description: Maestro case instance id, passed by the case plan as =js:(metadata.InstanceId). Keys the Data Fabric event row the case listens for.

injuryTypeCode.description: Type of injury claimed under the policy

settlementBasis.description: Basis of settlement, e.g. general damages or special damages

settlementPath.description: Settlement route, e.g. lump sum or periodical payment

decisionRationale.description: The recommendation and the reasoning behind it

notificationDelayDays.description: Number of days between the accident and the claim being notified

fraudScore.description: Fraud risk score for the claim

authorityLimit.description: The authority limit for this reviewer

recoveryAmountReceived.description: Amount recovered from a third-party insurer

liabilityCoverInForce.description: Whether personal injury liability cover is in force on the policy

contributoryNegligenceFlag.description: Whether a contributory negligence reduction has been applied

closureReasonCode.description: Reason code proposed for claim closure

settlementOutcome.description: Outcome of the settlement to date

decisionRationale.description: The rationale the reviewer records for their decision

evidenceHelpful.description: Which evidence the reviewer found most useful
